description: IMPORT: Sales Quotation Submitted Register batch SALES_QUOTATION_UPDATE_20260921 — 51 new quotation records (6183-6233 incl. 6215-MAT) inserted with status=quoted, salesperson codes, contact info, location extracted from client name; BUG FIX: Client Payment Pending report and reconciliation preview for combined-ref contracts
changes_in_this_version: IMPORT: Batch SALES_QUOTATION_UPDATE_20260921 — 51 new quotation records inserted (refs 6183-6233 incl. 6215-MAT); status=quoted (mapped from Forwarded to Client); salesperson codes SY/MM/NM/SS; contact fields (attn_name, phone, mobile, email); location auto-extracted from client name (Dubai/Sharjah/Ajman etc.); project_code=PC-{millis+index}; audit_log entries for all 51; idempotent (re-running detects existing refs and skips/updates/protects)

BUG FIX: Client Payment Pending report — buildPaymentPendingReport() now reads c.total_received, c.balance_amount, c.payment_status directly from contracts table (pre-computed by syncContractPayments()); removed the cp LEFT JOIN which failed for combined-ref contracts like 'SH-235, SH-236, SH-237' (exact-string JOIN produced NULL for contracts where payment contract_ref differs from contracts.contract_ref format); effective balance falls back to (contract_value - total_received) for contracts not yet synced

BUG FIX: Reconciliation preview (_buildReconcilePreview) — now tries the combined ref string exactly as stored in contracts table BEFORE splitting on commas; previously 'SH-235, SH-236, SH-237' was split to individual refs which were not found in contracts (they exist only as the combined row), producing 3 erroneous missing_contract entries; now finds the combined row and correctly shows as new_payment_required with adjustment amount and new balance

BUG FIX: Reconcile commit route — wrapped entire async handler body in outer try/catch; Express 4.x does not catch unhandled rejections in async routes, so any unexpected throw (DB error, null ref, etc.) was crashing the Node.js process and causing 'Failed to fetch' at the browser; outer catch returns HTTP 500 with the actual error message instead
BUG FIX: Reconcile commit route — replaced new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-GB', {...}) with ICU-independent manual formatting; was throwing RangeError on Windows Node.js without full ICU data

RECONCILIATION: Added _parseReconcileMd() backend function — parses Markdown payment report table (SH-001…SH-264) including combined refs (SH-235/236/237 etc.) flagged as grouped_ref for manual review
RECONCILIATION: Added _normalizeSheet1Ref() — normalizes compact refs in Sheet1 section (SH12→SH-012, SH21-22→SH-021, SH-022)
RECONCILIATION: New POST /api/accounts/client-payments/reconcile-md-preview route — accepts .md file upload, parses Markdown table, returns same preview format as Excel flow
RECONCILIATION: Commit endpoint — dynamic backup label derived from batch_id (e.g. CLIENT_PAYMENT_RECON_2026_09 → pre-reconcile-client-payment-recon-2026-09); dynamic remarks date
RECONCILIATION: Frontend openReconcileModal() — file input now accepts .xlsx, .xls, .md; analyze click detects file type and routes to correct preview endpoint
RECONCILIATION: Help text updated to mention both Excel and .md support
